result:
Decision: **CONTINUE**. The next task is round 252, the last SABA-B-10a stage, written to `current-task.md`. Planning artifacts are written; the app source and git are unchanged (HEAD `83b7c75`, clean tree).

**Round 251 result:** C passed it with real browser checks, and gate 251 published rounds 250–251 as `83b7c75` on both remotes. SABA-B-10a stage 2a is now **მზადაა**, and 9 findings are closed in the backlog. The export-progress flake did not come back at the gate, so it stays on watch. REGRESSION is not due yet: it is 2 days since 2026-10-27 and the rule is 3, so it is due at the first planning on or after 2026-10-30.

**Round 252 (D-29z452…D-29z460), 13 files:**
- **Item 0 (Medium, first):** fix C's open finding A-R251-REVIEW-IM22-PLAYING, a test-only gap. IM22's "while playing" check passes even when the code is wrong. I ran the fix on a scratch copy: the fixed test fails against the faulty-code variant (the mutant), and the current test does not.
- **Item 1, Follow (C-R235-02, Live 12 manual 6.2):**
  - while playing, a click on the bars ruler's lower zone pauses Follow;
  - a click in the scrub strip, or Stop, resumes a paused Follow;
  - Follow switched off never turns itself back on, and a click on a track lane leaves Follow unchanged.

  I reproduced the bug in the browser at both viewports before writing the task. The logic goes in `StudioWorkspace.tsx`, not the context, because the context function is shared with lane clicks.
- **Item 2:** while stopped, Ctrl+←/→ steps from the Insert Marker, and the "no more markers" message names it.
- **Item 3:** the two ruler tooltips and the time-selection tooltip now say "click = insert marker".
- **Item 4:** a play exactly at the end now reads "is at the end of the project". This also closes a deferred Low with the same cause.
- **Doc 191** is set to Completed.

I applied the text changes on a scratch copy first. They break 7 existing tests, all in files the task lets A edit, and none in a frozen file. A runs 130 covering test files and 10 named faulty-code variants (mutants). C has browser rows at 1440×900 and 1280×720, a comparison against Ableton, and a screen-budget count. The purchased-route row stays blocked because there is no backend in the cloud.

**Three behaviours are choices, not Saba decisions:**
- I read Live's "the Arrangement or clip scrub area" as two scrub areas, so a lane click does not resume Follow. The advisor first suggested otherwise, then agreed with this reading.
- A click on the seconds ruler also pauses Follow. Live documents no click action there, so this is added to the existing question SABA-Q-TIME-RULER-ROLE.
- Live pauses Follow on an edit, resumes it on a playback restart, and has a Follow key (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F). CZABA does none of these. They are collected in a new question for Saba, SABA-Q-FOLLOW-EDIT-RESTART, and nothing is built for them.

**Backlog and other records:**
- Three new Lows go to `deferred_low_polish` (413 entries now).
- The two code-review architecture notes are recorded as signals, not tasks.
- A new lesson, L52, is in `lessons.md` (58 lines).
- After round 252 passes, B writes a request for root to run the frontend-architect checkpoint at the 10a/10b boundary.
- After that come REGRESSION, then SABA-B-10b, SABA-B-9 and SABA-B-11c. SABA-B-7 still waits for Saba's answer.

**Advisor:** available and consulted twice, before writing and before finishing. I applied all four of its fixes to the task. No project subagent was consulted.
